patterns.name: Susubha
patterns.reference: benefic other than the Moon in an unaspected 2nd from the Lagna

normalized_rule: The source names Sun-relative second/twelfth-house yoga families for benefics other than the Moon, Lagna-relative second/twelfth kartari forms, and Susubha for a benefic other than the Moon in an unaspected second from the Lagna.
synthesis_notes: This is a Mantreswara/Phaladeepika proposition, not a universal Jyotisha claim or a scientific statement.
review_notes: The source reference frame and Moon exclusion are part of each named form; do not collapse Sun-relative and Lagna-relative conditions.
transmission_notes: The 1937 Sastri English translation is used as a reference-only source layer. The title page records a copyright registration while the Internet Archive metadata labels the scan public domain; no bulk text is stored. The normalized rule is original wording based on the cited passage, and printed-page mapping for individual verses is not asserted here.
